summary: Trinity Biotech filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing a strategic collaboration between its subsidiary Trinovium and Echelon Data Centres to develop liquid cooling systems for AI infrastructure. The collaboration is non-binding in terms of disclosed financial terms, with no stake, price, or value stated. The parties will develop direct-to-chip cooling fluids and modular cooling solutions. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The filing is a routine announcement of a business collaboration, not a special situation. Watch for future agreements or material developments, but no risk-arb angle applies.
